props.name: children
props.description: The element that triggers the card. It should be focusable, such as a link or button.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Delay before the card opens, in milliseconds.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before the card closes, in milliseconds.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the card lines up with.

props.name: above
props.description: Show the card above the trigger instead of below.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the card.
